rejected_approaches: P01 revision01: flat center lamp, missing raised hood inlet and tubular splitter. Repaired in revision02; G1 independently accepted.
P02 point-ray curb support caused excessive pitch. Replaced with five-sample wheel envelope selecting exactly one support/load per wheel; still only three tire-force channels.

P02 passive wheel-guard versus large convex ground slab generated an asymmetric solver impulse and uncommanded incline yaw. Diagnosed with contact instrumentation and repaired using planar ground triangles and frictionless passive guards. Strict three-lane regression failed before repair and passed after; maximum drift 0.01844 m and heading error 0.02958 degrees. See production/evidence/G2/revision02/dynamics-ramp-cause.md.

Held-reset based on clamped simulation elapsed failed real keyboard test. Replaced with continuous monotonic held time, clearing on release, pause and focus loss; final isolated keyboard recording verifies interrupted and fresh holds.

Initial cockpit captures were framed away from a car at z=35 and did not establish steering visuals. Preserved under G2/presenter-revision01; corrected capture reset to z=0 and independent reviewer inspected both final steering views.
commit_meaning: Implementation and capture checkpoint preceding this review-and-ledger commit. Accepted G2 runtime source is 8f115fcd44ab0d950e73fd7d24307aae1190e602; d047c56 corrects capture framing and documents the workflow without changing runtime source.
known_limitations: High-speed impact into an 18 cm vertical curb at 21.66 m/s produces about 3.48 m flight before recovery. G2 accepts this solely as a bounded severe-impact simcade approximation; not real crash/OEM behavior.
SwiftShader browser recordings run slower than wall-clock real time. Injected 30/60/120/144 frame caps validate simulation scheduling and final poses, not sustained physical render performance.
The accepted Slingshot is recognizable diagnostic clay; the other two vehicles are scale blockouts. No finished game or complete playable slice has passed.
